key_insights: Summer is uniquely suited for extracurriculars that can't fit during the school year since there's no homework/class competing for time

Recommends a mid-summer audit of your activity list to identify 'holes,' e.g., a CS applicant lacking CS-related activities, then targeting the next activity to fill that gap

reliability_notes: Speaker is a young YouTuber/self-described applicant, not an admissions professional or counselor, so claims (e.g., 'networking is your golden ticket to Harvard') are personal opinion/anecdote rather than verified admissions-office practice; casual and hyperbolic language throughout.
